description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for directory traversal, pattern matching, and ignore file handling in a Git-like version control system. It includes APIs for enumerating directory entries, handling ignore patterns, and managing untracked cache data.

methods.name: get_dtype
methods.description: Determines the d_type of a directory entry, possibly following symlinks if follow_symlink is set.

methods.name: count_slashes
methods.description: Counts the number of slash characters in a string.

methods.name: path_matches_pattern_list
methods.description: Checks if a pathname matches any pattern in a pattern list.

methods.name: is_excluded
methods.description: Determines if a given path is excluded based on ignore patterns.

methods.name: add_pattern_list
methods.description: Adds a new pattern list to the directory structure.

methods.name: add_patterns_from_file
methods.description: Adds ignore patterns from a specified file.

methods.name: remove_dir_recursively
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively based on flags.

methods.name: for_each_file_in_dir
methods.description: Recursively visits each file in a directory, applying a callback function.

methods.name: remove_path
methods.description: Removes a path and its empty parent directories.

methods.name: untracked_cache_invalidate_path
methods.description: Invalidates the untracked cache for a specific path.

methods.name: connect_work_tree_and_git_dir
methods.description: Links a worktree to a git directory by creating a .git file.

methods.name: relocate_gitdir
methods.description: Changes the location of a git directory.
